verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot's public code matching feature is documented (docs-11) as searching public repos for matches to suggestions, giving engineering leads visibility into public-code provenance, and community evidence corroborates that Copilot can surface/reproduce recognizable public code (comm-9, comm-11) validating the underlying detection concern. However, the evidence never explicitly confirms license metadata is surfaced alongside matches, nor provides independent hands-on confirmation of the matching UI/workflow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of license attribution details shown per match, and independent/hands-on verification of the feature's accuracy and UI.
